**Test image observations:**
- A single young shoot/leaf piece, curled into a C-shape
- Brown/yellowish-brown coloration throughout
- Crumpled, withered tissue with some spotting
- Characteristic curl/crimp pattern consistent with mechanical feeding damage

**Reasoning:**
The test image shows a brown, curled and crumpled young shoot — exactly matching the **Cutting_Weevil** description: *"Brown, curled and crumpled young leaves with visibly stripped shoots."* The characteristic tight curl of the young shoot tissue is the hallmark sign of weevil feeding damage on mango.

The Sooty_Mould reference (viewed) shows black encrustation on flat leaf surfaces — nothing like the curled/crumpled shoot in the test image. Other candidates (Die_Back = twig dieback with gum; Gall_Midge = round blisters; Powdery_Mildew = white powder) don't match either.
